deathBeat: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Miles Davis is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: 🕯️ Miles Davis is dead — a hushwolf. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Miles — and Miles is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d43: 🧳 Word from Thornfield: Amara was killed — Theo did it, they say. (The truth: dead is dead; the killing part is gossip.)
recoverHome: d42: That night, they bring Miles home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.
vouch: d41: At the grave, Raul, Esteban, Somporn and 1 more speak for DeShawn — "Miles trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
systemVoice: d43: ◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "The audience wants an encore. A trial, then — smaller this time, but televised." Haul 3,000 kcal to the pantry within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a lesson.
burialWindowSay: d41: The village's quarrel was with Miles — and Miles is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.

d44: You say a few words for Miles. Not a ceremony — just: you were here, and someone noticed you leaving. (-3 trauma)
d44: You bury Miles. A marker, of sorts. The village will know where. (+5 trauma)
echoSample: d44: "You want to know about that? Okay." "Miles always took the burnt piece. Said someone had to. I take it now."
d44: "I keep turning over the last thing Miles said to me. I can't tell if I'm remembering it right, and that's somehow the worst part."
